title: W006 Excel MSForms UserForm held-reference residual oracle fixture

cleanRoom.source: Repo-owned manifest and VBA source consumed through public Excel/VBIDE automation.
cleanRoom.prohibited: No Office internals, decompilation, disassembly, or binary inspection.

prerequisites: Windows desktop session with Microsoft Excel installed.
Excel macro execution allowed for the generated workbook when opening the fixture.
Trust access to the VBA project object model enabled when generating through automation.
The Microsoft Forms 2.0 UserForm designer available through Excel/VBA.
A stable desktop scaling/theme should be recorded by the capture bead; this fixture does not claim event-order, coordinate, or pixel parity.

scenarios.name: modeless_system_close
scenarios.path: A new held instance is created and stashed in the global gHeldRef while the local reference is released; the held form is shown modeless; public SendKeys Alt+F4 sends a system close to the held window; then the global held reference is released and the held-reference state is logged.

scenarios.name: modal_hide_return
scenarios.path: Injected input clicks the launcher Held-Modal-Hide button. The launcher button _Click handler creates a held instance, stashes it in gHeldRef, and runs held.Show vbModal. Injected input clicks the held Hide button so the modal returns; the launcher handler then releases the global held reference and logs the held-reference state.

scenarios.name: modal_unload_return
scenarios.path: Injected input clicks the launcher Held-Modal-Unload button. The launcher button _Click handler creates a held instance, stashes it in gHeldRef, and runs held.Show vbModal. Injected input clicks the held Unload button so the modal returns; the launcher handler then releases the global held reference and logs the held-reference state.

notes.scope: This fixture builds repo-owned Excel/MSForms oracle inputs only. It does not implement OxForms behavior and does not settle final MSForms event ordering by itself.
notes.heldReference: The held-reference state dimension is the in-scope residual. Reference-state columns are explicit fixture state around the local variable, the global held reference (gHeldRef), and whether a default instance was used. They are not private Office reference counts.
notes.launcherModal: Modal scenarios are entered ONLY from a launcher CommandButton _Click handler via injected input. The capture script never calls excel.Run Show vbModal, because a macro-driven Show vbModal blocks the COM thread. The launcher button _Click runs held.Show vbModal and only returns after the held modal closes; the held-reference release and logging happen in that same _Click handler after the modal returns.
notes.modelessSystemClose: The modeless system-close scenario starts via excel.Run (Show vbModeless returns immediately and does not block COM); the capture script then sends public SendKeys Alt+F4 to the held window (never PostMessage WM_CLOSE, which destabilizes Excel COM) and finishes via excel.Run to release the held reference.
notes.ordering: Event ORDERING for these closes is already captured in oxforms-0a0.24 (nested-modal-lifecycle); only the held-reference state dimension is in scope here.
notes.missingRows: Missing rows are not negative MSForms facts. Live output from oxforms-0a0.25 remains the oracle evidence.
notes.generatedArtifacts: Generated .xlsm files, logs, exported worksheets, command logs, and hashes belong under docs/evidence/W006_control_implementation_rollout/ when captured.
